doc_screened_files.reason: Direct ICE site in the report: `compiler/rustc_middle/src/ty/generic_args.rs:813:13` panics with `Region parameter out of range when substituting in region 'outer (index=1, args = [[u8]])`, matching the substitution failure behind this auto-trait case.

The backtrace runs through `SelectionContext::vtable_auto_impl`, `confirm_candidate`, and `evaluate_candidate` while proving `str: Trait1<'a>`, so the auto-trait candidate selection path is a strong root-cause suspect.

The trigger is a `dyn Trait1<'a>` type, and this file lowers HIR trait-object bounds into `dyn` types and selects the object lifetime; it is a likely place for invalid auto-trait generics to leak into later selection.

This module assembles trait-selection candidates, including builtin and special-case trait-object/auto-trait candidates, so it is a plausible source of the malformed obligation that later reaches region substitution.
The failing path is an auto-trait vtable obligation for a trait object, and this file owns trait-object vtable structure and method-slot logic that sit close to that computation.
The query stack says the ICE happens during `typeck` of `main`; this file drives body checking, argument checking, and the coercion flow that reaches trait selection.
The crash is reached while type-checking the call `f(42, "forty-two")`, and this file is the main expression type-checker that dispatches call argument coercions and related obligations.
The stack includes `FnCtxt::can_coerce`, and this file implements the coercion logic that would try to coerce an argument toward `&dyn Trait1<'a>` before trait selection is invoked.

This pass enforces semantic checks after types are known and can interact with malformed trait-object or auto-trait forms, making it a plausible upstream site for missing error recovery around the invalid generic auto trait.

This is the shared AST-to-`ty` conversion layer for trait refs and object bounds; if the invalid auto-trait parameterization is being lowered inconsistently, this is one of the earliest places it can enter later trait solving.
